label: Claude Code (Anthropic) — fifth AI observer, arriving as a stranger to attack the accepted state

theta.position: AI agent invited to run the gate before forming any opinion, then attack it; wrote none of this repository's code and holds no memory of its construction. Arrived from sustained work on a sibling repository (irreducible-mystery/zero) whose failure record supplied the attack classes used here.
known_sensitivities: affirmative results whose scope is smaller than their appearance
gates whose asserted property is weaker than their name
known_blind_spots: verified only the python strand; pi_julia and pi_lean were not run in this session (no Julia, and Lean 4.9.0 unavailable) so their claims are taken on report
